title: Show Tdarr Matrix Activity On Home
summary: Add a read-only Home page Tdarr Matrix activity signal backed by the existing diagnostics console payload.
reason: A long 100 percent Tdarr Matrix run can continue for many hours, and the operator needed a first-screen signal that the matrix is still actively running without opening Diagnostics.
behavior_before: Home had no Tdarr Matrix status surface, so an active matrix run was only visible from Diagnostics or filesystem/process evidence.
behavior_after: Home shows a Tdarr Matrix metric and compact panel with run status, progress, rate/ETA, finding count, and report readiness from the existing read-only diagnostics payload. The Home panel only links to Diagnostics and exposes no run controls.
tests_added: tests/webview/test_webview_frontend_mutation_boundary.py pins the Home Tdarr Matrix signal, optional GET route, and absence of Home run controls
